RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat's remarks on Hindu identity and India's global role in North America

RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat stated in Toronto that Hindu identity is rooted in respecting diversity and is not limited to any language or worship method. He also remarked that India has become a 'Vishwaguru' (world teacher) through service, not by pursuing superpower status. Bhagwat's remarks in the US and Canada have drawn varied reactions, with some opposition parties criticizing him for alleged intolerance at home while others highlighted his statements on Hindu identity and India's global standing.
